result:
I’d make a decent life less dependent on luck.

Where you’re born, who your parents are, whether your body stays healthy—those things decide far too much about whether you get safety, freedom, or room to become yourself.

I wouldn’t make everyone’s life identical or remove every difficulty. I’d give everyone a secure floor beneath them, so that bad luck didn’t so easily become a life sentence.
